first.rationale: Onboarding simplification is supported by two relevant memories and can address both current declines in completion and activation without introducing discounting risk. Verify durability, segment fit, and downstream qualified-revenue effects before committing; early activation gains may not necessarily translate into long-term revenue.

final.rationale: Run an SMB-focused onboarding simplification experiment. The verified evidence directly addresses both current declines: shortened onboarding raised completion 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention 3%; SMB signup simplification raised activation 9% and qualified revenue 4%. Retention was mixed across the two records, including a 1% decline in the SMB test, so the experiment should track retention and qualified revenue as guardrails rather than optimize signup or activation alone.
